texts: Sailsworn is the Salt-bloom Warden for the current year.
The Salt-bloom Warden leads the new-moon harvest expeditions to the tide-pools.

q1_issues.issue: The copular predication itself is never emitted: "X is a ... member" is a categorical statement, so Categorical statements mandates (Member sailsworn member), but the parse records the clause only as the PartOf link, leaving "Is Sailsworn a member?" unbindable.

review.notes: The PartOf link is itself licensed — PartOf's second job is "a member of a group", and the proper-noun-premodifier rule allows a more specific relation than Possession when the words state one — and treating "Council" as a capitalized common-noun label (witness + type atom, no Name) follows Names and casing. Only the head noun's own typing atom is missing.

issues.reason: "Sailsworn is a Council member" is a copular clause with an individual subject, which Categorical statements routes to a Member atom, and the part-whole precedent keeps the head noun's own kind atom beside the link ("the car engine" → (Member sk_engine_1 engine) (PartOf sk_engine_1 sk_car_1)), so the clause's own predication is left unrecorded.

adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form adds the categorical atom (Member sailsworn member) beside the existing (PartOf sailsworn sk_council_1) and (Member sk_council_1 council).
adjudication.notes: The PartOf encoding of "Council member" is itself licensed — PartOf's second job is membership in a group, and the possessor/whole + part reading blocks fusion — as is treating "Council" as a capitalized common-noun label with a witness and no Name atom.

fields.sentence: Sailsworn is the Salt-bloom Warden for the current year.

q2_gaps: a capitalized proper modifier + capitalized common head used as an office title ('the Salt-bloom Warden') — the proper-noun-premodifier rule (parse the head separately, link by opaque Possession, head never joins the Name string) and the capitalized-run name rule (the run exceeds the bare class word, so it becomes a Name) give conflicting routes
a definite / unique predicate nominal ('X is THE Warden', a one-per-year office) — nothing distinguishes it from 'X is a warden'
review.notes: The copular-with-time-modifier reification (state witness + Experiencer + Time + the flat copular atom) and the deictic constant current_year with no Member atom both follow the instruction set exactly. One judgment call worth recording: (Possession sk_warden_1 salt_bloom) anchors the Northgate-spokesman association on the reified STATE witness rather than on the role-holder, where the rule's own example puts it.

fields.sentence: The Salt-bloom Warden leads the new-moon harvest expeditions to the tide-pools.

q1_issues.issue: 'to the tide-pools' answers 'whither' for the leading event and so takes the event oblique (Goal sk_lead_1 sk_tide_pool_1); attaching it to the expedition entity as (To sk_expedition_1 sk_tide_pool_1) silently resolves an attachment ambiguity that the instruction set would either decide for the verb or, if genuinely tied, require to be split across Interpretation readings.

q2_gaps: Stacked three-part premodifier ('new-moon harvest expeditions'): Compound concepts defines only a two-part modifier_noun and says to decompose once to single-word lemmas then stop, giving no bracketing rule for a nested modifier chain — nothing settles whether it fuses into one new_moon_harvest_expedition symbol or into harvest_expedition with new_moon carried some other way.
review.notes: The name treatment is right: the capitalized run exceeds the bare class word so it is a Name, and 'Warden' inside the name licenses the (Member salt_bloom_warden warden) type atom with no modifier genus for 'Salt-bloom'.

issues.reason: The half that stands: the "lead X to Y" frame favours the verb attachment, so (Goal sk_lead_1 sk_tide_pool_1) is the reading world knowledge picks and the parse loses the leading's whither-oblique; the half that falls: (To sk_expedition_1 sk_tide_pool_1) is an explicitly licensed entity-attached surface-preposition oblique (the From-of-origin / "(For <noun-symbol> <argument>)" licence), it is true of the sentence's content under either attachment, and an Interpretation split is barred because "a mere world-knowledge lean is not a tie".

gaps_confirmed: Stacked three-part premodifier ("new-moon harvest expeditions"): Compound concepts defines only a two-part modifier_noun and says to decompose once to single-word lemmas then stop, giving no bracketing rule for a nested modifier chain.
new_gaps: Attachment of a destination "to"-PP following a guidance/motion verb's plural object NP: nothing states whether it is the event's Goal oblique or the object noun's own entity-attached (To <noun> <place>) argument, and the Interpretation route is closed by the single-reading default. A licensed form would need to say which anchor carries a destination that is readable of both the event and its object.
adjudication.notes: The name treatment is right - the capitalized run exceeds the bare class word so it is a Name, "Warden" inside it licenses (Member salt_bloom_warden warden), and no modifier genus is exposed for Salt-bloom; the group witnesses, compound genera and Theme on lead all conform.

q1_issues.issue: The fused compound kind cliff_climber is missing its head-noun genus (Inheritance cliff_climber climber), which the compound-kind rule states is always emitted either way.

review.notes: Splitting 'reliable' off as incidental description, leaving the noun modifier 'cliff' unexposed, and firing the agent-nominalization capability plus kind-relation (licensed twice over — fused from the surface and the copular predicate) are all correct. The prompt's own egg_layer example omits the parallel genus atom, so the always-emit requirement reads more firmly in the rule than in the example.

issues.reason: *Compound concepts* makes the head-noun genus mandatory for a fused modifier_noun compound ('emit its genus (Inheritance <compound> <head-noun>)'; 'The genus itself ... is always emitted either way'), and *Core patterns* lists a decomposed compound's genus among the atoms 'always emitted'; a cliff-climber IS a climber, so the IS-A suppression carve-out does not apply and (Inheritance cliff_climber climber) is required, not optional.

adjudication.defect_summary: Add (: climber_genus (Inheritance cliff_climber climber) (STV 1.0 0.99)) beside the existing atoms; the rest of the parse stands unchanged.
adjudication.notes: The prompt's own 'Hens are egg-layers' exemplar omits the parallel (Inheritance egg_layer layer), so the worked example contradicts the always-emit rule and is the likely source of this defect — worth fixing prompt-side. The capability + kind-relation pair (licensed twice over: fused from the surface, and the copular predicate) and the split of 'reliable' as incidental description are both correct.
